experimental_model: Forge V5 TripoSR native extractor, original pretrained model
assessment: Native and scikit-image extraction generate effectively equivalent learned geometry, with a coordinate-order mismatch in the custom adapter. Forge remains soft and melted; changing the mesh extractor did not improve feature interpretation.
next_controlled_test: A/B inputs with different hard-surface contrast and silhouettes while keeping model weights, marching cubes and inference parameters constant. Evaluate known Forge reference alignment instead of triangle count.
